   with branching stems, and very small and abundant leaves and flowers.
pinweed.translation: n. 多年生半日花科植物(Lechea); 北美岩蔷薇; 芹叶太阳花

pinwheel.definition:
n. perennial subshrub of Tenerife having leaves in rosettes resembling pinwheels
n. a wheel that has numerous pins that are set at right angles to its rim
n. a toy consisting of vanes of colored paper or plastic that is pinned to a stick and spins when it is pointed into the wind
pinwheel.translation: n. 轮转焰火, 纸风车, 快速旋转的东西

pinwheels.definition:
plural of pinwheel
n. perennial subshrub of Tenerife having leaves in rosettes resembling pinwheels
n. a wheel that has numerous pins that are set at right angles to its rim
n. a toy consisting of vanes of colored paper or plastic that is pinned to a stick and spins when it is pointed into the wind
pinwheels.translation: (pinwheel 的复数) n. 轮转焰火, 纸风车, 快速旋转的东西

pinwork.translation: n. (针绣花边的)细小凸出饰纹

pinworm.definition: n. small threadlike worm infesting human intestines and rectum especially in children

pinx.translation: abbr. pinxit (Latin=he/she painted it) （拉丁语）（某某）画

pinxit.definition:
A word appended to the artist's name or initials on a
   painting, or engraved copy of a painting; as, Rubens pinxit, Rubens
   painted (this).
pinxit.translation: v. <拉>(用于画家署名后)(某某)所画(或所作)

piny.translation: a. 松树的, 松树般茂盛的

pinyin.translation: <汉>n.拼音(指汉字拉丁化注音和拼写方案)

pinyon.definition: n any of several low-growing pines of western North America
